control_contract.default_state: PB6_RUN held low/high-Z on reset through R_AFE_PERMIT_PD; AFE_OK and WD_OK fail low via existing candidate pulldowns; SN74LVC1G11 Y goes low and asynchronously asserts FF /CLR; PB5_ARM held low by moved R_QP_GS; FF Q therefore defaults low when CORE logic is valid.
control_contract.latch_action: When AFE_OK, WD_OK, and PB6_RUN are all high, AND Y releases /CLR. Only a fresh PB5_ARM rising edge clocks D=3V3_CORE to Q. Any health input low asynchronously clears Q. Removing a fault does not re-arm Q; firmware must issue a new ARM edge.
control_contract.current_fault_path: For current-window faults to isolate SC, reuse G431 COMP1/COMP2 open-drain AF outputs wired active-low into AFE_OK; those outputs also feed the hardware TIM1 break path with AOE=0. Confirm actual STM32G431 output type/AF and polarity before schematic freeze. DRV8161 nFAULT itself is read by AUP1T14 to PA10 and PB12/TIM1_BKIN; it does not directly clear this FF in the present 3-input logic.
control_contract.driver_readback: Add U_DRV_FAULT_FB=SN74AUP1T14DCKR and C_DRV_FAULT_FB=100nF; DRV_FAULT_N goes to AUP input, Y to PA10 and candidate PB12/TIM1_BKIN. Do not feed AUP Y or DRV pin4 back to the same FF /CLR because Q-low/R_DRV_FAULT_PD can create a non-rearmable feedback lock.PB12 is currently assigned to NTC_DUMP in the existing pin plan; if PB12 is assigned TIM1_BKIN, move the NTC_DUMP input to PA0 as the root plan specifies. No extra component is needed, but recheck pin AF/input mapping.

physical_topology_and_protection.mosfet_pin_contract: Both HYG022 FETs: pin1=G; pins2-8=S; pin9 and tab=D. Q_ISO1/Q_ISO2 pins2-8 share ISO_MID. Their pin9/tab drains go separately to SC_ISO_STORAGE and SC_FUSED. Both gates pin1 share ISO_G. Do not reverse D/S.
physical_topology_and_protection.back_to_back: Common-source series pair. ISO_MID is the common source; the outer drain nodes are storage side SC_ISO_STORAGE and bridge side SC_FUSED.

clamp_paths.name: D_LO
clamp_paths.role: provides the lower recirculation clamp after isolation when the low-side switch is shorted

clamp_paths.name: D_HI
clamp_paths.role: closes the high-side-short recirculation loop and limits SC_FUSED to approximately BUS_BR+VF

physical_topology_and_protection.cap_requirement: Replace both SC_FUSED local 100uF/35V polymer capacitors by parts rated above maximum BUS_BR plus clamp forward voltage, ringing, tolerance, and transients; 63V is a candidate minimum only if this bound fits. Check negative clamp pulse versus polarized capacitor reverse-voltage rating.

pulse_screen.assumptions: L=20uH nominal; one-shot current examples 80A and 110A; clamp drop 0.7V illustrative, not guaranteed maximum.
pulse_screen.qualification: Must use actual L minimum, current ceiling including sensing/logic/gate delay, diode I2t/thermal initial condition, repetitive duty, bus maximum and wiring parasitics. IFSM rating alone does not qualify.

known_unclosed_requirements.issue: 12V_DRV recovery can auto-reenable an armed isolation switch
known_unclosed_requirements.evidence: If 3V3_CORE remains alive while 12V_DRV falls, FF Q may remain high. LTC7001 VCCUV disables TGDN below its UVLO but does not latch the fault; on VCC recovery, INP still high can reopen the switch.
known_unclosed_requirements.required: Add an independently powered 12V-loss-to-FF-/CLR path, then require a fresh PB5_ARM edge. This required path is not included or costed in current arrays; no auto-start PASS.

known_unclosed_requirements.issue: LTC7001 TGDN at VCC=0 is not guaranteed
known_unclosed_requirements.evidence: ADI datasheet describes TGDN-to-TS action during UVLO and gives output resistance with powered conditions; it does not guarantee a low-impedance TGDN state at VCC=0.
known_unclosed_requirements.residual: R_ISO_GATE_SOURCE=10M gives only weak passive discharge and no specified turn-off time. If 12V_DRV and 3V3_CORE both disappear, fast default-off is unproven.

known_unclosed_requirements.issue: FF Q shared high-level margin at two gate-driver inputs
known_unclosed_requirements.evidence: One R_GATE_SER=680R drives DRV pin4 and LTC INP in parallel. Guaranteed VOH with the 10k DRV pull-down and both input thresholds has not been closed at min 3V3, max temperature, and process corners.
known_unclosed_requirements.residual: Candidate only, not PASS. Do not substitute the nominal 20us DRV response for end-to-end current interruption.

known_unclosed_requirements.issue: Total interruption time and fault energy are unqualified
known_unclosed_requirements.evidence: System time includes comparator/AFE detection, AND/FF, LTC7001, gate charge discharge, and inductor current decay through clamps.
known_unclosed_requirements.residual: DRV8161 local timing/deglitch values are not total switch-to-zero-current time. No physical qualification performed.

known_unclosed_requirements.evidence: STPS80H100TV is specified 700A IFSM for a nonrepetitive 10ms sine; capacitor reverse pulse and actual bus-fed QH-short loop are not covered by that single rating.
known_unclosed_requirements.residual: Candidate route only; compute full I2t/thermal and waveform margin before release.

known_unclosed_requirements.issue: PB6_RUN high level through the reused 10k/47k network has narrow guaranteed margin
known_unclosed_requirements.evidence: The project-root corner estimate is approximately 2.14V at the SN74LVC1G11 RUN input, only about 0.14V above the 2.0V maximum VIH boundary before input leakage and rail/process/temperature corners.
known_unclosed_requirements.required: Recompute from the G431 guaranteed VOH at the actual source current, AND input VIH maximum and leakage, pull-down tolerance, and full temperature. Keep this a candidate until the margin is guaranteed or change the resistor ratio.
